Under our policy, a parcel is considered lost after 10 business days with no tracking update (P-4). If NW1004 has had no update for 12 business days, it has passed that point. However, my records show NW1004 as "In transit" with no last-update date, so I can't see its tracking history or confirm whether it has been marked as lost.

What you can do:
- Open a claim for NW1004 within 30 days of its promised delivery date (15 Nov 2026). That means by 15 Dec 2026 at the latest (P-4).
- Compensation is the declared value of the parcel, up to 500 EUR. NW1004's declared value is 30 EUR.

I can't open the claim from this chat, and the policy doesn't say how claims are submitted, so I can't give you the exact channel. Please let me know if you have any other questions about your shipments.
